data.name: ProcessIntro
data.value: Whether you are starting from scratch or improving an existing project, you follow the assessment, development and launch.

data.name: ProcessStep1Desc
data.value: We understand your goals. If you already have a website or system, we assess its structure before proposing changes.

data.name: ProcessStep2Desc
data.value: We agree on scope, priorities and the visual and technical solution your project needs.

data.name: ProcessStep3Desc
data.value: We build or improve interfaces, backend functionality and integrations, and test how they work.

data.name: ProcessStep4Desc
data.value: We launch your project and agree on hosting, maintenance and future improvements to suit your needs.

data.name: FaqQuestion1
data.value: How much does a website cost?

data.name: FaqAnswer1
data.value: Each project has its own scope. The investment depends on pages, features and integrations. A brief helps prepare a proposal that fits your needs.

data.name: FaqQuestion2
data.value: How long does a project take?

data.name: FaqAnswer2
data.value: The timeline is agreed after we understand the project. Complexity, content preparation and approval stages are all considered in the plan.

data.name: FaqQuestion3
data.value: Will my website work on mobile?

data.name: FaqAnswer3
data.value: Yes. The layout is designed to adapt to phones, tablets and computers, with navigation and content suited to each screen size.

data.name: FaqQuestion4
data.value: Do you maintain websites built by other teams?

data.name: FaqAnswer4
data.value: Yes. We maintain and improve websites built by HTS or other teams. We assess the code, user experience and infrastructure to identify the changes needed.

data.value: HTS — HowTo.Software. Websites from scratch, maintenance of existing projects, backend development and hosting for your business.

data.name: ServiceBackendDesc
data.value: What happens behind the interface matters too. We develop APIs, business logic, databases and integrations that connect your website to the tools you use.

data.name: ServiceHostingDesc
data.value: Your project ready to go live. We configure hosting, domains and deployment, or assess migrating an existing website to infrastructure that suits your business.

data.name: FaqQuestion5
data.value: Do you also develop the backend?

data.name: FaqAnswer5
data.value: Yes. We develop APIs, business logic and integrations with databases and external services. We can work on a new project or assess the infrastructure you already use.

data.name: FaqQuestion6
data.value: Can you host and launch my website?

data.name: FaqAnswer6
data.value: Yes. We handle hosting setup, domains and deployment. Infrastructure, recurring costs and ongoing support are agreed in the proposal based on your project needs.
